events.verdict: Durant (HOU) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds.
Murray (NOP) is in the paint for less than three seconds when he moves to imminently guard an opponent.
Finney-Smith (HOU) is already in Jones' (NOP) path when contact occurs, and he firms up to absorb the marginal contact during the screen.
Following the initial contact during the screen, Jones (NOP) appears to lose his balance and incidental foot-to-foot contact occurs with Finney-Smith (HOU), that causes him to fall to the floor.

Replay review of the goaltend called on Smith Jr. (HOU) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful. Smith Jr. blocks the shot attempt after the ball makes contact with the backboard and has a chance to score.
Murray (NOP) directly contests Durant's (HOU) jump shot attempt, making legal, incidental contact to Durant's hand after the release.
Finney-Smith (HOU) makes contact with the ball that dislodges it away from Matkovic (NOP) after he secures the rebound.
Sheppard (HOU) initiates contact with Williamson's (NOP) arm, which affects his driving shot attempt.
Thompson (HOU) steps toward Murray (NOP) and marginal contact occurs before Murray steps out of bounds.

Murray's (NOP) right foot steps out of bounds while he is in possession of the ball. The out of bounds violation is correctly called prior to any ensuing contact to Murray's arm. Possession is awarded to the Rockets (HOU).
Finney-Smith (HOU) takes longer than 5 seconds to release the throw-in.
Jones (NOP) and Durant (HOU) briefly engage and disengage off-ball.
Jones (NOP) contests the jump shot attempt and avoids making contact with Durant's (HOU) arm.
Jones (NOP) comes to a stop and marginal contact occurs off-ball, as Finney-Smith's (HOU) momentum brings him slightly forward. The contact does not affect Jones' ability to get to the inbound pass.
